violation_type.title: Background Check Validation - You must inactivate a subject who is no longer associated with your operation within 7 days of leaving (26 TAC §745.651(1))
violation_type.short_title: Background Check Validation - You must inactivate a subject who is no longer associated with your operation within 7 days of leaving
violation_type.typical_finding: Based on information obtained during the investigation, it was determined that an employee who left in October 2025 was not inactivated until February 2026.

finding_variants.text: Based on information obtained during the investigation, it was determined that an employee who left in October 2025 was not inactivated until February 2026.

A background check for two people no longer employed with the operation was not inactivated within seven days.    Note: This was corrected at inspection as the background check was inactivated during inspection.
A former assistant caregiver's background check had not been inactivated per minimum standard.
One employee was observed to have an active background check after seperating from the operation.
One of the staff members was still active after their last days of work was February 27, 2026.    NOTE: This was corrected at inspection when they were made inactive.
A staff member who is no longer with the operation has not been inactivated within seven days of leaving
